fullContentHtml:
KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025 – Full Details

KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal before the closing date. Review all important dates, application fee requirements, eligibility criteria, and instructions given below. Important: 03 March 2025 is the deadline to submit the online form.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 November 2024
  • Application Start Date : 11 December 2024
  • Last Date : 03 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 March 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2360/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1416/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete registration with your basic details, mobile number, and email.
  3. Fill the application form carefully with educational and personal details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of required documents, photograph, and signature.
  5. Pay the examination fee online and take a printout of the confirmation page.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025?

KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025 is an official government job recruitment notification. Interested candidates can check eligibility criteria and apply online via direct official links provided above.

How to apply for this vacancy?

Candidates can apply online directly through the official recruitment link in the Important Links table above.
